::: {.callout-note}
## Developer Reference

This is a UIAO JSON Schema, rendered as a developer-reference page per
[ADR-072](../../adr/adr-072-canon-publication-policy.qmd).

- **Source:** [`src/uiao/schemas/overlay-fabric/overlay-fabric.schema.json`](../../../src/uiao/schemas/overlay-fabric/overlay-fabric.schema.json)
- **Dialect:** `https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema`
- **`$id`:** `https://whalermike.github.io/uiao/schemas/overlay-fabric/overlay-fabric.schema.json`
:::

## Description

Constrains the application-aware overlay fabric configuration for the `overlay` mission class (UIAO_204, anchored by ADR-066 / ADR-123). Governs (a) the in-boundary token-issuer configuration whose fields UIAO_203 references (token_format, max_token_lifetime_seconds, signing_key_rotation_days), (b) the registry of overlay / SD-WAN / SASE / service-mesh fabric entries, each carrying a token-issuer reference and a posture-source reference, and (c) the typed OverlayTunnel runtime record. UIAO observes and reconciles overlay state; it does not route packets or terminate tunnels (ADR-066 lane discipline).

## Top-Level Properties

| Property | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `metadata` | object |  | Optional canonical frontmatter per src/uiao/schemas/metadata-schema.json when this schema governs a registry document. |
| `schema-version` | string | ✓ | Semantic version of this overlay-fabric document schema. |
| `updated` | string | ✓ | ISO 8601 date of the most recent fabric-config update. |
| `issuer` | object | ✓ | The in-boundary overlay token-issuer configuration. UIAO_203 §4 selects Path A: the issuer runs inside the GCC-Moderate boundary with in-boundary key custody. |
| `fabrics` | array&lt;`$ref: #/$defs/fabricEntry`&gt; | ✓ | Registry of overlay fabric adapter entries. Order is stable; new entries append. |

## Full Schema

```{.json filename="overlay-fabric.schema.json"}
{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "$id": "https://whalermike.github.io/uiao/schemas/overlay-fabric/overlay-fabric.schema.json",
  "title": "UIAO Overlay Fabric Schema",
  "description": "Constrains the application-aware overlay fabric configuration for the `overlay` mission class (UIAO_204, anchored by ADR-066 / ADR-123). Governs (a) the in-boundary token-issuer configuration whose fields UIAO_203 references (token_format, max_token_lifetime_seconds, signing_key_rotation_days), (b) the registry of overlay / SD-WAN / SASE / service-mesh fabric entries, each carrying a token-issuer reference and a posture-source reference, and (c) the typed OverlayTunnel runtime record. UIAO observes and reconciles overlay state; it does not route packets or terminate tunnels (ADR-066 lane discipline).",
  "type": "object",
  "required": [
    "schema-version",
    "updated",
    "issuer",
    "fabrics"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false,
  "properties": {
    "metadata": {
      "description": "Optional canonical frontmatter per src/uiao/schemas/metadata-schema.json when this schema governs a registry document.",
      "type": "object"
    },
    "schema-version": {
      "type": "string",
      "pattern": "^[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+\\.[0-9]+$",
      "description": "Semantic version of this overlay-fabric document schema."
    },
    "updated": {
      "type": "string",
      "format": "date",
      "description": "ISO 8601 date of the most recent fabric-config update."
    },
    "issuer": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The in-boundary overlay token-issuer configuration. UIAO_203 \u00a74 selects Path A: the issuer runs inside the GCC-Moderate boundary with in-boundary key custody.",
      "required": [
        "token_format",
        "max_token_lifetime_seconds",
        "placement",
        "posture_source_ref"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "token_format": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "spiffe-svid-x509",
            "spiffe-svid-jwt",
            "jwt",
            "paseto-v4-public"
          ],
          "description": "Wire format of issued overlay tokens (UIAO_203 \u00a72.2). Symmetric-secret formats are intentionally absent \u2014 they are non-conforming."
        },
        "max_token_lifetime_seconds": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "maximum": 300,
          "description": "Canon-declared maximum token lifetime (UIAO_203 \u00a73.1). May be lowered per deployment; never above 300 without a superseding ADR. A token whose exp-iat exceeds this is a DRIFT-OVERLAY P1 finding."
        },
        "signing_key_rotation_days": {
          "type": "integer",
          "minimum": 1,
          "default": 90,
          "description": "Issuer signing-key rotation cadence (UIAO_203 \u00a73.3). Overlapping validity windows let in-flight tokens validate across a rotation boundary."
        },
        "placement": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "in-boundary",
            "declared-exception"
          ],
          "description": "Issuer placement. `in-boundary` is Path A (preferred, no boundary exception). `declared-exception` is Path B and requires `exception_ref`."
        },
        "exception_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Reference to the gcc-boundary-gap-registry.yaml exception entry authorizing an out-of-boundary (Path B) issuer. Required when placement == declared-exception."
        },
        "key_custody": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Identifier of the in-boundary key-management surface holding the issuer signing keys (HSM, in-boundary CA, verified-credential service, or in-boundary SPIFFE/SPIRE)."
        },
        "posture_source_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Reference to the posture-telemetry conformance adapter supplying the device/application posture axis of token issuance (UIAO_203 \u00a72.1)."
        }
      },
      "allOf": [
        {
          "if": {
            "properties": {
              "placement": {
                "const": "declared-exception"
              }
            },
            "required": [
              "placement"
            ]
          },
          "then": {
            "required": [
              "exception_ref"
            ]
          }
        }
      ]
    },
    "fabrics": {
      "type": "array",
      "description": "Registry of overlay fabric adapter entries. Order is stable; new entries append.",
      "items": {
        "$ref": "#/$defs/fabricEntry"
      }
    }
  },
  "$defs": {
    "fabricEntry": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "A single overlay / SD-WAN / SASE / service-mesh fabric the substrate observes and reconciles.",
      "required": [
        "id",
        "kind",
        "mission-class",
        "token_issuer_ref",
        "posture_source_ref",
        "status"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "id": {
          "type": "string",
          "pattern": "^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9]$",
          "description": "Stable slug identifier for the fabric entry."
        },
        "vendor": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Fabric vendor/product (illustrative; UIAO does not pick a vendor)."
        },
        "kind": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "sd-wan",
            "sase",
            "service-mesh"
          ],
          "description": "Fabric category."
        },
        "mission-class": {
          "type": "string",
          "const": "overlay",
          "description": "Always `overlay` (the sixth mission class, ADR-123). Distinct from the identity-plane `*_transport` write seams."
        },
        "token_issuer_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Reference to the token-issuer this fabric's tunnels are authorized by (UIAO_203)."
        },
        "posture_source_ref": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Reference to the posture source feeding this fabric's enforcement decisions."
        },
        "status": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "reserved",
            "proposed",
            "active"
          ],
          "description": "Lifecycle of the fabric adapter entry."
        }
      }
    },
    "overlayTunnel": {
      "type": "object",
      "description": "The typed OverlayTunnel runtime record (ADR-066 \u00a7Decision #3). Tunnels are LEASED, not opened; the lease is bounded by token lifetime. The lease.expires_at <= token.exp invariant is normative in UIAO_204 \u00a74 and enforced at reconciliation, not by JSON Schema.",
      "required": [
        "identity",
        "application",
        "posture",
        "location",
        "token",
        "lease"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false,
      "properties": {
        "identity": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Caller identity (token `sub`)."
        },
        "application": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Target application (token `aud`)."
        },
        "posture": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "Device/application posture digest at lease time."
        },
        "location": {
          "type": "string",
          "description": "orgPath + LocPath binding (token `loc`)."
        },
        "token": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "jti",
            "exp"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "jti": {
              "type": "string",
              "description": "Unique token id (single-use)."
            },
            "exp": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "date-time",
              "description": "Token expiry."
            }
          }
        },
        "lease": {
          "type": "object",
          "required": [
            "leased_at",
            "expires_at"
          ],
          "additionalProperties": false,
          "properties": {
            "leased_at": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "date-time"
            },
            "expires_at": {
              "type": "string",
              "format": "date-time",
              "description": "Must be <= token.exp (UIAO_204 \u00a74 invariant)."
            }
          }
        },
        "certificate_chain": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "Optional certificate chain anchoring the tunnel."
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```
